narrator.name: Requirements Reuben
narrator.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something exists but is broken: it used to work, or someone started it, and it stopped or stalled. Describe the workaround people use today because it does not work, never that it does not exist. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The automated consent validation scripts for the loyalty basket feeds are currently failing. They used to flag mismatches before the data reached the feature store, but the pipeline has stalled. The team now manually extracts a small sample of raw scan lines each morning. They cross reference these entries against the retention log by hand to verify the personal data fields. This manual check happens every morning before the nightly batch processes the new data. It is the only way the data gets through to the forecast job right now.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state of the pipeline failure and the manual workaround without expressing any wishes, refusals, or explicit trade-offs.
